title: Retire the legacy design capability
situation: The `cratylus design` capability, over the earlier record store, still shipped beside the concept journal and read design records from the working tree, plan branches and worktrees: a second account of the design. Judgment of cut 3 found it; decision 0013 requires a removal the design names.
decision: Retire the legacy design capability, because the concept journal is the only account of the design. It is removed from what cratylus delivers, and anything that reached it is re-pointed at `cratylus concepts`.
consequences: `cratylus design` no longer exists; the concept journal (`cratylus concepts`) is the one way to record and read the design.
